scripts.deploy:storage:dev: node -e "if (process.env.BLAZE_ENABLED !== 'true') { console.error('Storage needs the Blaze plan. Set BLAZE_ENABLED=true to deploy (docs/FIREBASE-SETUP.md section 10).'); process.exit(1) }" && firebase deploy --config ../firebase.json --only storage --project dev
scripts.deploy:storage:prod: node -e "if (process.env.BLAZE_ENABLED !== 'true') { console.error('Storage needs the Blaze plan. Set BLAZE_ENABLED=true to deploy (docs/FIREBASE-SETUP.md section 10).'); process.exit(1) }" && firebase deploy --config ../firebase.json --only storage --project prod
